answer: New sessions start on probation: they can read and vote, but high-value actions are locked until the session proves consistency over time. Probation is short for genuine users and endless for farms, because a farm's sessions never accumulate the consistency a real operator builds. One garden proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of behaviour. A reef and a quartz may look alike, but only the session with a consistent pattern is honoured.
